wars.name: Qi conquest of Tan

zones.text: Tan, 'located just east of present-day Jinan'; capital Mingshui (Zhangqiu), Shandong

wars.outcome: Qi besieged and occupied Tan's capital for three years from 684 BC and then made the ruler its vassal; the infobox ends the state in 684.
wars.note: The page also places a Qi attack on Tan's last viscount, Xian Li, 'Later in October of that year' (1046, after Muye) and says he fled to Ju; its own table dates that attack to 684. The two do not agree and the 684 date is used. The ruler table gives reign dates only for the first five viscounts (1046-921), so no ruler strip is written.

certainty.note: No Tan boundary is on the page; the capital site itself is contested (Mingshui or Tancheng). Soft throughout.

notes: Pages opened (2 of 1-2): Tan (state), List of Zhou dynasty states. Wikidata id left null (unreachable). SLUG tan is the 譚 of Shandong (annexed by Qi); not Tan 郯 (annexed 414, slug tan-state suggested by ea-01-d) nor Tan 檀. START -1046 is the infobox year (confidence 2: the page's sentence does not name the founder). END -684 follows the infobox; the page's text says the line then continued as a Qi vassal, and its Qi-attack-after-Muye sentence conflicts with the 684 table date: unresolved. The qi dossier (ea-01-b) has no matching gain. AREA: none on the page. Mingshui is Zhangqiu, which is not a gazetteer place; the disc is by coordinates.
